implementation_notes: The kernel is a library of headers (or a shared schema) both contexts include; keep it free of implementation and behind a stable API. Make the co-ownership visible in the build: a single shared static library that both link.
idiom_name: shared header/library + one CI job covering both consumers
pitfalls: Header-only kernel that grows until every context recompiles on every edit
Static state in the kernel becoming a hidden global
